text: Gardening is an engaging way to nurture plants and create a serene outdoor space. The foundation of any successful garden is a well-prepared soil, and compost is the essential ingredient that enriches the soil’s texture and nutrients. As gardeners add compost, they create a rich, crumbly base that sustains plant health and encourages the growth of vibrant and productive plants. Once the compost is adequately distributed, gardeners can then lay down a generous layer of mulch to further protect and preserve the soil. This protective layer of mulch helps retain moisture, suppresses weeds, and guards against erosion, ensuring that plants remain healthy and thriving throughout the growing season.
